evidence_note: KI-16a un-fusion. CrossRef author[12] of 10.1021/acs.energyfuels.6b02643 is 'Yuri E. Corilo' (13 authors; McKenna is author[11]). The MagLab CSV row maglab:9938 typed '.' instead of the ';' author delimiter, producing the single token 'McKenna, A.M. CORILO. Y.E.', so 02b_extract_csv.py emitted a McKenna edge and NO Corilo edge for this paper. This restores the missing edge. Deterministic per-DOI CrossRef lookup against the cached response, NOT text extraction and NOT inferred. author_sequence 12 is CrossRef's true position; the CSV-derived edges on this paper carry a resulting off-by-one from author 12 onward (Headley sits at 12, CrossRef says 13) — not corrected here, as those records are 02b output.
